notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
description:
Cast Dream Stalker, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
